project.name: HumanoidArena HOI Teleop VLA Stack
project.description: Focused knowledge graph for the HOI teleoperation, replay, scene-randomization, VLA dataset, and LeRobot training path: GMR/Pico/TWIST2/SONIC inputs feed Isaac Lab action providers, recordings capture canonical 64D state plus 40D action with environment-object and vision metadata, and LeRobot trains or serves policies back into the simulator.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Repository-level operator guide for TWIST2 and SONIC live teleoperation, Isaac Lab recording, and replay startup order.

nodes.name: code_structure.md
nodes.summary: Architecture note focused on isaaclab_twist2_g1 data flow through Pico or TWIST2 input, action providers, simulation stepping, image streaming, and recording fields.

nodes.name: motion_retarget.py
nodes.summary: Implements GMR's core inverse-kinematics retargeter that scales human motion, maps tracked body frames onto robot tasks, and solves MuJoCo and Mink IK for G1 qpos targets.

nodes.name: xrobot_teleop_to_robot_w_hand.py
nodes.summary: Original TWIST2 teleop publisher that reads XRobot and Pico frames, retargets them with GMR, builds 35D mimic observations plus hand and neck commands, and publishes live control and recording signals through Redis.

nodes.name: run_twist2.sh
nodes.summary: Main Isaac Lab live entry for TWIST2 HOI recording; clears Redis keys, selects env and task parameters, and launches sim_main.py in pico_twist2 mode.

nodes.name: run_sonic.sh
nodes.summary: Main Isaac Lab live entry for SONIC whole-body control; wires Redis pose input, encoder and decoder checkpoints, camera streaming, and recording output into sim_main.py.

nodes.name: run_vla.sh
nodes.summary: Launches Isaac Lab in VLA mode by routing sim_main.py through the TWIST2 backend while fetching high-level actions from a LeRobot HTTP server.

nodes.name: sim_main.py
nodes.summary: Unified Isaac Lab runtime: applies env YAML, creates action providers, starts DDS/camera streams, coordinates reset/replay restore, object seed restore, and recording loops.

nodes.name: create_action_provider.py
nodes.summary: Backend factory that routes sim_main arguments to TWIST2, SONIC, OpenPI, direct replay, or backend-specific replay providers.

nodes.name: action_provider_wh_twist2.py
nodes.summary: TWIST2 backend for live teleop, replay, rerecording, VLA-assisted control, multicamera video sidecars, object seed metadata, and canonical 64D/40D supervision.

nodes.name: action_provider_sonic.py
nodes.summary: SONIC backend for Redis/ZMQ pose input, encoder/decoder inference, replay/rerecord, reset barriers, multicamera recordings, canonical VLA state/action, and heading-aware root handling.

nodes.name: vla_smpl_runtime.py
nodes.summary: Canonical motion runtime for 64D observation state, 40D action, quaternion/rot6D conversion, TWIST2/SONIC joint order, SMPL wrist extraction, and backend adapters.

nodes.name: lerobot_vla_http_client.py
nodes.summary: Thin HTTP client that sends camera RGB plus canonical state to remote LeRobot inference and receives canonical VLA action predictions.

nodes.name: recording_common.py
nodes.summary: Reusable async NPZ episode recorder used by SONIC and shared recording paths to save large episode buffers without blocking the control loop.

nodes.name: image_server.py
nodes.summary: Camera streaming service that reads rendered images and publishes them over ZMQ, Redis, DDS, or XRobot H264, enabling headset-side visual closed loop during teleoperation.

nodes.name: twist2_teleop_server.py
nodes.summary: Integrated teleop bridge inside isaaclab_twist2_g1 that mirrors TWIST2 live publishing, adds reset and input-ready coordination, and can emit SONIC-compatible joint29 references from the same Pico stream.

nodes.name: pico_server_pose_only.py
nodes.summary: SONIC-oriented Pico pose server that converts VR body tracking into SMPL-based pose batches, hand commands, and Redis or ZMQ payloads for whole-body control.

nodes.name: TWIST2_DATA_FORMAT.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the TWIST2 recording NPZ schema, including robot_obs_buf semantics, replay-critical fields, and stored robot, human, and vision arrays.

nodes.name: VLA_PROPRIOCEPTION_FINAL.md

nodes.name: CANONICAL_G1_ACTION.md
nodes.summary: Design document for the canonical 40D action that unifies SONIC and TWIST2 targets in robot space and explains why root delta, root rot6d, joint29, and hand binary were chosen.

nodes.name: smpl_lerobot_common.py

tour.title: Read The Workflow Docs
tour.description: Start with repository and Isaac Lab docs to align live, replay, data-format, and scene-randomization terminology.

tour.title: Trace Human Motion To Robot Targets
tour.description: Follow XRobot/Pico motion through GMR and TWIST2/SONIC pose publication before the simulator consumes backend commands.

tour.title: Enter IsaacLab Runtime
tour.description: Open run scripts, sim_main, env YAML loading, and the provider factory to see how launch parameters become a concrete backend.

tour.title: Inspect Live Backends
tour.description: Compare TWIST2, SONIC, OpenPI, replay providers, reset barriers, and shared recording/video helpers.

tour.title: Understand Canonical VLA Schema
tour.description: Read schema docs and vla_smpl_runtime to understand 64D state, 40D action, root rotation layout, and backend adapters.

tour.title: Configure Tasks And Scene Seeds
tour.description: Inspect per-task YAMLs, scene configs, runtime hooks, and object reset utilities that make live recording and replay restore share one scene state chain.

tour.title: Replay And Rerecord Episodes
tour.description: Follow replay scripts, rerecord wrappers, object-state restore, reward summaries, and multicamera video sidecar processing.

tour.title: Convert Recordings Into Datasets
tour.description: Use conversion helpers, TWIST2/SONIC exporters, rerecord/video tools, and verifier tests to turn raw episodes into stable LeRobot datasets.

tour.title: Train Or Serve Policies
tour.description: Finish on LeRobot: batch plans schedule training, dataset utilities repair/merge data, and the HTTP server connects inference back to Isaac Lab.
